summary: Veugen Technology is a family company in Nederweert, Netherlands, that builds fogging machines used to apply sprout inhibitors in seed and ware potato stores. It also supplies cleaning and hygiene products. Frans Veugen founded it in 1988 or 1989, and his sons Rob, Paul and Jos have owned it since 2010.
ownership: Family-owned by Rob, Paul and Jos Veugen
machines: Halofog 300 PC: container fogger for potato storage
Halofog 900P: basic fogger model for sprout inhibition
Halofog 300 Hatch: Halofog 300-series fogger for potato stores
Halofog 300: Halofog 300-series fogger for potato stores
Halofog 300 1P: Halofog 300-series fogger for potato stores

facts: Renamed from Frans Veugen Bedrijfshygiëne B.V. to Veugen Technology B.V. in 2023
